Changes how fast sound travels for the doppler shift, in meters per second. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
; Under water, sound is more than four times as fast as in air.
SpeedOfSound 1480, 500
```
@param meters  Meters per second, `340` (the speed in air) until it is changed. It has to be above 0, anything else is a runtime error.
@param fade_ms  How many milliseconds it takes to get to the new value. `0` (the default) changes it at once. Below 0 is a runtime error.
@gap [CreateListener](CreateListener) does not change it. [GetSpeedOfSound](GetSpeedOfSound) tells the value.
